title: Check a fit with right angles
brief: Measure how far a fit is from perpendicular, project the targets onto the column space, and decide when a fit is the best one.
hints: residual_orthogonality: r = y - X @ w, then float(np.abs(X.T @ r).max()).
project: the fitted values are X @ fit_normal_equations(X, y), which has shape (n,), not (d,).
is_best_fit: compare residual_orthogonality(X, y, w) with tol * np.abs(X.T @ y).max().
